notes.title: Early Access Update v.1.0.
notes.notes:
This version has a new stat editing module, use the customized featured units to create levels!

1. Go to the [Edit Attributes] tab

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/1b6740a9b089f6199c52ceb4e80b0d6e8570712e.png[/img]

2. Select the content to be edited, including "Combat Units - Combat Stats" "Construction Units - Combat Stats" and "Construction Units - Functional Stats”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/09df209788b29a98c5a104a675dd1f285a0c4851.png[/img]

3. Select "Combat Units - Combat Stats" to edit the Stats of all combat units. The data list on the left side contains all editable units, select a unit to edit；

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/b577f9698ad6096a61481e31b745d89c18bdf6f4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/9b0948199a0a0af1c8f7e4687f99c7e24a6ea007.png[/img]

4. After editing the stats, the changes take effect instantly. The editable attributes of combat units include:  
HP: Basic HP, the unit will die when it reaches 0
ATK: Basic ATK
ATK Range: Unit attack range(units: meters)
ATK SPD: Unit attack speed (units: second/time)
DEF: Defense rate, final damage value = ATK *(1-DEF)
Recovery: HP recovery speed (unit HP/s)
Movement SPD: Unit movement speed (units: m/s)
Vision Range: A radius of a circle centered on the unit that will automatically attack when an enemy appears within that range (units: meter).
Fog Dispersal Range: The radius of a circle centered on the unit, within which no fog will exist
Resource Occupied: The resources deducted when the unit was recruited (generally affecting the resources themselves) are returned when the unit dies
Resource Used: The resources deducted when the unit was recruited (generally affecting the resources themselves) are returned when the unit dies

5. "Building Unit - Combat Stats" and "Building Unit - Functional Stats" are also similarly edited, where "Combat Stats" are removed compared to the combat units, and a barrier value is added.
Barrier: buildings are infected when the barrier value is gone (buildings are not infected if the initial barrier value is 0).

“Stat functions” include: 
Construction time: the time required to complete the construction of the building (in hours).
Power grid range: range of the power grid brought by the building (in meters).
Resource collection range: the collection range of a collection building (in meters).
Max. number of buildings that can be built: the maximum number of buildings that can be built, cannot build more buildings once you reach the limit.
Pre-research: fill in the research id, the building can only be built after R&D
Pre-build: fill in the building id, the building with this id must exist on the map before the building can be built.
Upgradeable building: fill in the building id, the building can be upgraded to a building with the corresponding id after it is built.
Resource occupied: the resources deducted when the building is constructed (generally affects the resource output), returned after the building is destroyed.
Resource consumption: the resources deducted when the building is constructed (generally affects the resource output), returned after the building is destroyed.
Construction costs: resources deducted once when constructing a building, generally returned 50% after the building is destroyed.
Construction reward: resources granted upon completion of building construction, deducted after building infection/destruction.
Power-up bonus: resources granted after building construction is completed and deducted after the building is powered off/infected/destroyed.
Collection efficiency: the length of the building's production cycle (in hours).
Collection rewards: the resources produced by each production cycle of the building, deducted after the building is powered off/infected/destroyed.
List of units hatched after infection: enemy units that appear after the building is infected.
Ignore the split matrix skill - [Sandworm Disaster]: This skill will periodically summon sandworms to randomly destroy non-essential buildings in the base, if this option is selected, the building will not be targeted by this skill.

Hello Captains, in this update we have brought brand new content to the Map Editor and also made minor adjustments to the existing game content.

[b]Map Editor:[/b]
In the new version, we bring you the Event Editor template, so now you can create unique gameplay by defining unique rules!

1. Tap the [Event Edit] button to enter the corresponding page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/2cab69b8c85fcbe63730c8285cf62e2a73118a73.png[/img]

2. A list of triggers is shown on the left:
  2.1 Trigger template: 
    2.1.1. In the drop-down list, you can select different trigger templates, clicking on the + on the right 
    will create the corresponding trigger, it is recommended that you use the template to build it first so 
    that you can have a better understanding of our trigger mechanism.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/34f2ea2223bfdfdf62150f6bbf241e6fc5b6860f.png[/img]

  2.2 There are three types of triggers: Standard, Round, and Timed. 
    2.2.1. All three triggers have the same functions, both round and timed come with their own templates, 
    if the requirements are consistent with the template, it is recommended to use the corresponding 
    triggers directly for easy classification management
    2.2.2. Round trigger: The default trigger event is "at the end of each frame"
    2.2.3. Timed trigger: The default trigger event is "when the game time changes"
    2.2.4. game_initer: Comes with a trigger that will perform the initialization behavior at the beginning 
    of the game and is recommended to be kept.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/67922ea57a6b55bc9631a9d8316402a25ff4b4f8.png[/img]

3. The right side is the trigger configuration interface:
  3.1. Trigger name: Fill in the trigger name (every name is unique and cannot be duplicated)
  3.2. Trigger event: The trigger will be activated when the corresponding event is triggered during the 
  game and will enter the "condition check" process (some events with their own parameters will be 
  displayed next to them)
  3.3. Condition check: fill in the expression, when the result of the expression execution is true, it will 
  enter the "execution behavior" process (if not filled in, the default is true)
  3.4. Execution behavior: fill in the expression, and the expression will be executed sequentially

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/c95fbfc20b396968594927aed834a796b3b4af4f.png[/img]

4. In the upper right corner of the trigger configuration interface, there is a data query button, click on it to open the data table (excel), which contains all available expressions, event descriptions, descriptions of relevant variables, etc. You can imitate the form of the template and use the table to configure more triggers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/0e588219ea6b536bd1e63e19e5f177b907e770ca.png[/img]

notes.title: Alien Marauder-Map Editor Help Document
notes.notes:
Welcome to the map editor! With it you can create original maps for the game, so show us your best and share it with everyone in the steam workshop!
Here's how:

1. Click【<color=yellow>New</color>】to create a empty map
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/fd460ea7a7a0eda447c75d5b8fc38775b2e12ecd.png[/img]

2. The "Map info" interface will appear once the map is created, here you have to arrange the basic values in it, including:
2.1.Map Name: Name your map for further exhibition.
2.2. Theatre type: choose a theatre type for your map.
2.3. Game Mode: Enable/Disable heroes for your map.
2.4. Map description: Describe your map to inform everyone about its unique mechanism and features. 

3. Now it’s all yours, paint your own landscapes with brushes, or implement a random landscape generation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/4b4f44cb81fc89593043d38e695dd5d1a21f5688.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/df7913c5eb05e00767386d9dd7108f1f89839a92.png[/img]
3.1:"Paint" landscapes, click "paint landscapes" to call the interface.
3.1.1 Brush type: choose between landscape and vexan brushes, with brushes you can create your own landscapes or place enemies for your map.
3.1.2.Brush Size :Square brushes are provided with the editor, switch between different sizes to meet your requirements.
3.1.3:Select Brushes: Choose a brush to paint in your map.(Click mouse right to release your current selection)
3.1.4. Brushes edit layer priority: Vexans>Landscapes, which means that, the vexans generated by the brushes will be placed over the landscapes rather than replacing them. However, brushes of the same type will still replace each other when applied.

3.2.Generate Landscapes: Click "Generate Landscapes" to call the interface.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/c91927734f088cf304f2348564fe7431fa446d0b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/f72a97107e7f3d308cfbcaa402a0dd2c1cb3ee04.png[/img]
3.2.1: Landscape type: Choose the landscape type you prefer to generate.
3.2.2. Start Point Radius: Set the start point of landscape generation and the distance between the point and the center point of your current theatre. (the value must be an integer between 0-200)
3.2.3 End Point Radius: Set the end point of landscape generation and the distance between the point and the center point of your current theatre.(the value must be an integer between 0-200)
3.2.4.Generation Quantity: Numbers of landscape grids generated in a single generation the value determines the percentage of grids generated in the process.(Float: 0-1)
3.2.5.Dispersion tendency :Dispersion of generated grids, the grids would be more likely to assemble with a higher value or vice versa.(Float: 0-1)
3.2.6.Evolution correction value：This value determines the ratio of grids during the evolution progress. The value accumulates whenever a blank area is generated, and be referred to prevent dispersed landscapes from being evolved, causing the overall landscape percentage to decrease. (Float:-1 to 1)  
3.2.7.Landscape evolution counter：Times of evolution applied to random-generated landscapes, higher the value, more likely you’ll get a smooth terrain.
3.2.8. “Generate landscapes” Button: click to implement a randomization by the current setup and generate a set of landscapes.
3.2.9 “Landscape evolution” Button: click to implement a correction process in landscape dispersion, making them to be more assembled.
3.2.10 “Reset”Button: Click to reset all changes applied to the map (landscape and vexans)

notes.title: The Introduction of Alien Marauder
notes.notes:
Alien Marauder is a real-time strategy game. In the game, players need to build their own base with initial resources, continuously develop technology and population, and establish a base. At the same time, Captains need to always be vigilant and defend against "Vexans" attacks from all directions until they are finally eliminated.

[b]Survival Mode[/b]
Standard survival game mode, players need to control a space expeditionary army, that landed in the middle of a random map, through patient strategic planning, non-stop construction of buildings, resource collection, building an army, killing vexans, and expanding their territory to gradually become stronger, and finally hold on for 100 days, or defeat 10 waves of vexans to win!
In the plot, the player controls Commander Layton from the Expedition Force and Baldur from the Pickaxe Mining Company, with the main goal of trying to survive and collect as many minerals as possible.

[b]Hero features in this mode:[/b]

[b]Commander Layton:[/b] Control the aircraft, marksmanship is very accurate, and he can keep Vexans out of the base walls!
[olist]
[*] Important defense equipment: Ion cannon
[*] Special equipment: Orbital Strike Coordinator
[*] Important combat unit: Transform tank
[/olist]

[b]“Chainsaw” Baldur:[/b] Wears a heavy mecha suit, and swings his chainsaw to kill everything in his path.
[olist]
[*] Lack of defensive facilities, but his soldiers have extremely high resistance to attacks.
[*] Important combat unit: Destroyer Mecha
[/olist]
More defense strategies and weapon combinations are waiting for you to explore!

[b]Defense Mode[/b]
Innovative real-time strategy plus Roguelike mode, players need to control an army of mercenaries to land on an unfamiliar planet, and fight random types of vexans, each time you defeat the vexans in the wave you will be rewarded with resources and random skills, players need to use these random skills to create a strategy, and then use resources to focus on getting stronger and making better buildings, and finally defeat the endless army of vexans to win!
In the plot, players control mercenary generals Bilson and Gavius to directly confront the vexans using violent methods in order to eradicate their existence (by the way, take the skulls of the vexans to the black market for money).

[b]Hero features in this mode:[/b]

[b]Bilson:[/b] The captain of the space pirates, and the expeditionary force signed a contract of employment to fight the vexans he believes that the cooperation with the expeditionary force offers many opportunities for personal enrichment, which is much faster than robbery. In battle, Bilson is a man who will do whatever it takes, whether it's using a crossbow or sniper rifle to assassinate, or using a giant cannon, as long as he can destroy the enemy.

[b]Gavius:[/b] First Officer Gavius can stay calm when boarding the ship or the landing pods, but he is always equipped with heavy mechas and rushes to the frontline in the battle.
Operating skills will determine whether you can survive in defense mode, but luck is also an important factor here! Hope you can get the chip you desire. 

Good luck, Captains!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Spoiler Episode 4: Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
Hello Captains! This is the last preview, today we are going to introduce the renovation of Alien Marauder's gameplay. Are you looking forward to it?

Before we begin, let’s take a look at the recent game updates:
- 3 new vexan units
- 1 new defense tower
- 2 new were maps added in the Survival Mode (currently 4 maps in total)
Alien Marauder will start the EA version on November 18th of 2021.

[b]Game Settings & Hotkeys[/b]
Like other RTS games, in Alien Marauder you can modify your gameplay settings, click "Setting" on the main screen in order to modify them. The system has two sets of shortcut keys for players to set, although the game plan provides a preset value, players can adjust according to their own habits, after all, you should use what suits you best!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/ba5e9b1655cdd18380760cc69fdfaf5676e69c46.jpg[/img]

[b]Game Difficulty[/b]

[b]Survival Mode[/b]
As stated in Spoiler Episode 2, Survival Mode has two different victory goals. Under the same conditions, "Mode 2" is more difficult than "Mode 1".
The Difficulty Score ranges from 30 to 1,245, and players can adjust the difficulty by themselves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/90bab84cf48f8513db17adb7c009c170a744795c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/a043d750f36765db6b9645134c87e9ade8fe5452.jpg[/img]

We sincerely suggest that new players start with 30 points of difficulty, first adapt to the rhythm and operation of the game and get familiar with the game content, and then go on and challenge higher difficulties. However, if you’re dying to challenge the highest difficulty, we can only pray for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/1032d19d7d44d1e796eb266d35b3f47a1df71210.jpg[/img]

[b]Defense Mode[/b]
In the defense mode, we have added the hell difficulty and suicide difficulty. Because the creators are still stuck in the basic mode, they failed to unlock these two difficulties, but I saw colleagues and other captains’ videos doing the challenge, 100,000 aliens on the same screen need to be experienced by the captains themselves. If you successfully finish the challenge, remember to send us screenshots or videos of it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/bfc4c38f2f31fd720fe8cb42f988a46f46126811.jpg[/img]

[b]Hero Design[/b]
After choosing the game mode and difficulty you’ll decide which hero to use, each mode currently provides two heroes, the captains need to choose one of the four heroes, of course, the hero’s damage and positioning are different, players can choose their hero according to their play style. For example, Layton is good at long-range attacks, while Baldur is good at melee combat (specific heroes can look back at Spoiler Episode 1). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/499b309d1e1b780e8132522aafe2dccdc32c5e5e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/9bd90c3300803e421f50f76af8811c17756337fd.jpg[/img]

The hero system is one of our most important systems, and we have given a lot of thought and verification to the design of hero skills, initially divided into three parts: peripheral skills, combat skills and operational skills.

Peripheral skills: is the general game "proficiency", proficiency growth will give the hero some additional benefits, but as proficiency increases, the benefits are more on the honor level than on the numerical level, preventing overpowering at high proficiency

Operational skills: Each hero has completely different operational skills in building, gathering, and troop composition, with some heroes favoring economy, long-range, army leadership and others favoring melee combat, and their own strength.

Combat skills: specific to the game, because as mentioned before we do not want players to overuse micromanagement to gain a great advantage, combat skills are basically based on this concept, generally by 2 active +1 passive +1 ultimate, 2 active skills need some release timing and positioning requirements, the cooldown is very short, which is also the biggest requirement for the operation, passive skill generally only provides value growth, and the ultimate is a strategic skill, it generally has a very special use depending on the situation, rather than the other skills.

The above three points make up the basic design idea of our heroes, like having the root of the tree and the fork of the foundation, and what we do subsequently is to make combinations on these basics to provide players a completely different game experience as much as possible.

notes.title: Spoiler Episode 3: Operation Interface Update
notes.notes:
Some Captains may have found that the art style of Alien Marauder has changed a lot. Our team has been committed to exploring more appropriate art styles for Alien Marauder. We have done many surveys about art style before. Have you participated? If not it’s totally fine, we still opening to accept any suggestions or advice.

The unique UI design not only fits the worldview setting and atmosphere of Alien Marauder, but also deepens the players' first impression and experience of the game. Therefore, our R&D team pays great attention to the design and spends a lot of time and effort to polish it.

[u][b]The main "Retro Steampunk Style" version 1.0[/b][/u]

Early in the project's inception, the game's overall UI is a retro steampunk style, the designer's inspiration comes mainly from the Pirates of the Caribbean style and mechanical style.

As you can see from the picture below, we can see that the UI design of version 1.0 is more inclined to show the information to the user as comprehensively as possible in the overall layout, without taking into account the player's habits in the process of operation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/5d008fc750a4ff50579b1ec4f29133033d965558.jpg[/img]

During the internal debugging, we found that the UI design of version 1.0 showed the important data completely, but there were many inconveniences and problems in the actual version use such as:
1.  If the player clicks on the function buttons with the mouse, sometimes they even need to span the whole computer screen, such as the "Repair" button, which is on the lower left side of the screen, and the "Menu" and "Home Base "buttons are at the top left of the screen. For new RTS players who are not used to using a hotkey, it is not very convenient.

2. Although a lot of information is placed on the Hub, it does not highlight the key information visually. For example, the time of the insect wave is very easy for players to ignore.

3. Failing to match the backstory of Alien Marauder to a high degree: the backstory has always conveyed two important concepts - technology and the future. And these two concepts need a richer design approach to express these ideas better.

[u][b]Iterate on the foundation of the updated version 2.0[/b][/u]

Based on these three major issues, we have optimized and iterated over version 1.0

One of the most obvious visual changes in version 2.0 is that the overall layout has changed significantly:

1. The function bar in the upper left corner in version 1.0 was moved to the lower right, and all the buttons that need to be operated were placed at the bottom of the screen to improve the sense of interface operation.

2. The information sidebar notification box was added, so that players can immediately notice the key information.

3. The overall interface is more concise, reducing the sense of heaviness and increasing the sense of technology.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/13c6bec61c853d1e86048d9ef8695bbf54d0a670.jpg[/img]

In July 2020, we had invited a group of players to participate in the first closed beta test. They gave us feedbacks and there were imperfections in the interface interaction and inconvenient operation, as well as feeling that the game's technology was not particularly obvious.

This is obviously an unexpected and unintended result for UI designers. For this reason, we listened carefully to the players' opinions and analyzed them together according to their habits and game objectives, and came to the conclusion that the key information is still not obvious enough, and the current layout will make players lose their focus; secondly, the visual feeling of the interface is also not beautiful enough.

In order to be able to give players a better visual and operating experience, UI designers stayed up late working their butts off in order to change a lot of the first 2 versions of the design, and the main interface for a further overhaul.

[u][b]Focus Futuristic Technology version3.0[/b][/u]

First of all, in the overall design level, besides sticking to the previous simple information distribution, we will pay more attention to the portrayal of futuristic and technological feeling, and make each UI lighter; secondly, the designers studied the interface flow of many console games and found that besides the simple UI, the console games will use a lot of special “shader” and dynamic effects to render the atmosphere of a more technological feeling.

In addition, the focus on the combination of model and UI is also a major feature in the packaging of many systems. We hope that when players experience each system, the immersion will be a little stronger and they will be able to receive the worldview-related settings from the interface level.

Therefore, the main interface of version 3.0 is cleaner than the previous 2 versions, the main interface has all the functions categorized and organized, so that the function partition is clear.

The Hub interface of the survival mode is divided into six main areas:
1. General information: Hero, soldier information and winning conditions
2. Vexan information: No. of vexans and incoming insect wave alert
3. Resource information: The number of all resources
4. Location information: Map, pause button, acceleration button, and survival time
5. Detailed information: Detailed information about the vexan mastermind in the corresponding map, the time of the next attack, and the detailed properties of the mouse-selected element
6. Function console: including all function buttons and chip reward display

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/85bc716ca7eceb8451527d9429d6d37e2c8823fb.jpg[/img]

The Hub interface of the defense mode is basically similar to the survival mode, with a few areas changed.

1. General information: Added instant information reminders, players can quickly understand the status according to reminders
2. Vexan information: Red warning reminder information, more prominent sense of tension in the defense mode
3. Resource information: Added vexan information and reward table, and you can control the information bar by clicking the mouse to expand or collapse

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/19a6a737b3e895c9297044deb05074a3b8e0eacf.jpg[/img]

Behind each UI design, we hope to interpret the two concepts in Alien Marauder: [b]technology and future[/b], more accurately. Secondly, we hope that each time we sort out the system structure, we can give players a better sense of game interaction and experience.

Thank you for your patience in reading this captain, if you have suggestions and comments on the art and other aspects, please feel free to give us feedback, it is very valuable to us. Please also support Alien Marauder more in the future!

There is no end to this journey to the alien planets, and we are always on the move!

notes.title: Spoiler Episode 2: Scene Update – Survival Mode
notes.notes:
Humanity is on the verge of resource depletion, after centuries of uncontrolled mining of the planets in the solar system, including Earth. Humans have no choice but to form multiple expeditionary armies to explore the vast planets in various galaxies to seek new resources.
These are deserted planets due to their long-term exposure to strong radiation, resulting in vegetation mutations, species living on the planet are also forced to evolve due to radiation and eventually go against the human race to keep going on their evolutionary path.
The vexan belong to the group of omnivores with a quite fast reproduction speed because of living in dark environments for long periods of time also their vision isn’t as developed as you might think, but they are very sensitive to sound, their sound perception range varies depending on the type of vexan.

[b]SOMETHING IS WATCHING YOU[/b]
Each map corresponds to a different Vexan Mastermind, each with its own unique abilities and units.
The Mastermind is always watching, and if you lower your guard for just a second, the Mastermind will definitely send elite vexans to attack your base.
Pay attention, Captain! Remember, there are eyes watching you all the time.

[b]Blazing Gobi[/b]
Although the climate here is hot, the good thing is that the vegetation is abundant, mineral resources also provide sufficient nutrition for the vexans they do not have to worry about the food source, so they have an extremely strong reproductive capacity.
[b]Vexan Lord[/b]: Incubation Lord
[b]Lord’s Ability[/b]: Split Matrix – Periodically summon split matrix, split matrix will spawn masses of vexans when attacked.
[b]Elite unit[/b]: Incubator type

[b]Frostland[/b]
Ice and snow starvation, in order to adapt to the harsh environment, the vexans living here evolved into a fly species, they’re stronger and have higher HP.
[b]Vexan Lord[/b]: Night Watcher
[b]Lord’s Ability[/b]: Outpost Guarding – Periodically randomly select an outpost near the mastermind outpost to place guards, outpost guards have a strong combat ability and can attack from afar.
[b]Elite unit[/b]: Flying-type

[b]Optional Killing Method[/b]
In Survival Mode, you need to control a space expeditionary army that landed in the middle of a random map, through patient strategic planning, non-stop construction of buildings, resource collection, building an army, killing vexans, and expanding their territory to gradually become stronger, and resist the vexans’ attack.
We have two victory modes for maps in Survival mode, and only two maps in the current Play Test version, corresponding to each of the two victory modes.

[b]Mode #1[/b]
[b]Map[/b]: Blazing Gobi
[b]Objective[/b]: Survive 10 vexan waves or a designated number of days.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/a7191e5d08cfce537cff02097e1c2c79ce75a8ad.jpg[/img]

[b]How[/b]:
1. Every time the game comes to a specified point in time, a wave of vexans will appear from the edge of the map and take the initiative to attack the player's base, as the wave increases the number and intensity of each wave of vexans will continue to increase. You’ll be informed about the direction of the wave beforehand

2. In addition to the basic units, elite vexan units will appear in specific waves, and the special abilities of these units sometimes require additional countermeasures from the player.

3. Vexans will come from all directions in the final wave, while all remaining wild aliens on the map will also actively participate in the attack.

[b]Mode #2[/b]
[b]Map[/b]: Frostland
[b]Objective[/b]: Destroy the mastermind outpost to delay the all-out vexan attack and survive a designated number of days.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40985397/4767f0ead21edf93986df67dd05706cff1ff2b2f.jpg[/img]

[b]How[/b]:
1. The construction basics is the same as mode 1, but there is no longer a timed attack, instead there’s a full-scale attack that will take place much earlier than the number of days in order to achieve victory, There is no limit to the number of aliens that can appear from outside the map after the full attack has begun, and they refresh repeatedly until the end of the game

2. Players need to destroy the initial randomly generated alien buildings on the map called mastermind outposts to delay the attack. Every time you destroy one of these vexan buildings, you’ll delay the final attack for several days, but will also lead to a wave of retaliatory attacks by the vexans.

3. The more mastermind outposts are destroyed, the stronger the retaliating vexans will be. Players need to control the rhythm of the game themselves and clear all the mastermind outposts in an orderly manner according to the ability of their own troops.

4. When all the mastermind outposts are destroyed, the difference between the number of days of a full-scale attack and the number of days of victory is not that much, and the player only needs to hold on for a few days under the full-scale attack finishes in order to achieve victory.
